residual_risks: The preloaded SSLContext is process-wide and mutable through urllib3 pool internals. Trusted in-process code that mutates a pool's context could change verification behavior for other adapters using the shared context; this requires access to private transport objects and was not treated as a user-triggerable defect.
testing_gaps: No tests were run, as instructed. Cross-adapter concurrent use and mutation of the shared context were not exercised.
